d39: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d39: 🕯️ Tiana is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d39: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d39: 🕯️ Tiana Weiss is dead — the arena. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d39: What Tiana kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d39: "Tiana's gone." Howard looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Tiana." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d39: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Olivia blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d39: 📖 LEARNED: Camp Cooking (Level 1). Cooking uses half the water, +10% kcal. Once per day: add a Secret Ingredient (a random inventory item) — 50% delicious (+morale), 50% educational.
d39: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
